tagline.text: Panay's flagship SM mall since 1999, a shopping hub that keeps growing

location.label: Location
location.text: Senator Benigno Aquino Jr. Avenue (Diversion Road), Mandurriao District, Iloilo City

best_season.label: Best time to visit
best_season.text: Year-round (indoor mall; getting around is easiest in the December–May dry season)

budget.label: Budget
budget.text: About ₱300~2,000 (per person, meals, transport and light shopping)

children.text: SM City Iloilo opened on June 11, 1999 as the flagship SM mall on Panay Island, on Diversion Road in the Mandurriao district. It has grown several times since 2009 with The South Point, North Point and more, and large redevelopment and new construction are still under way, making it the center of shopping, dining and movies in Iloilo.

SM City Iloilo is a large shopping mall on Senator Benigno Aquino Jr. Avenue, commonly called Diversion Road, in the Mandurriao district of Iloilo City. It is developed and operated by SM Prime Holdings and, according to Wikipedia, opened on June 11, 1999. SM's official page describes it as the eighth SM Supermall built by Henry Sy Sr. and the second biggest shopping mall in Western Visayas, and gives a total gross floor area of about 105,953 square meters. The land area differs between the official page (about 170,000 square meters) and Wikipedia (about 183,281 square meters), so just think of it as a very large mall.

The mall is not one block but a complex added to over several periods. The Main Building built in 1999 is the core, and Wikipedia says it underwent a major renovation from the second quarter of 2008 to the first quarter of 2009. The dining-focused South Point was added in 2009, and in 2015 a North Point wing with more than 165 shops and restaurants and a larger Cyberzone opened. On November 11, 2016, the South Point was greatly expanded on a former parking area. According to SM Prime materials, leasable area grew from about 72,000 square meters to about 106,000 square meters between 2009 and 2016. SM Strata, an office twin-tower complex, is attached and linked to the mall by a pedestrian footbridge.

For travelers, this mall is less a sightseeing attraction than the center of everyday life in Iloilo. In air-conditioned comfort you can change money, buy a SIM card, visit a pharmacy, shop at the supermarket, see a movie and eat, all in one stop. It has an SM Store department store, SM Supermarket, an appliance center, a food hall and food court, and a Cyberzone focused on electronics. Wikipedia lists six cinemas, including an IMAX with Laser theater. It is handy on the day you arrive or leave Iloilo, for a first grocery run before or after you unpack, or as a place to wait out a sudden shower.

The biggest change to watch now is the large redevelopment. In November 2025, SM Prime said it would finish a redevelopment costing about ₱2.3 billion in the first quarter of 2026. It covers refreshed interiors, motion-sensor escalators, an enlarged skylight, rooftop solar panels, a multi-level car park in the North Block, and better links to SM Strata. A National University (NU) campus is also planned in the North Block, reportedly targeting a 2027 opening. Wikipedia says the third-level Cyberzone opened on August 28, 2025 and the rest of the third level on December 30 of the same year. Construction schedules differ slightly between reports, and the opening times of individual areas keep changing. Please check the latest announcements before you go.

Opened in 1999, this mall has become the center of Western Visayas shopping, so much so that one daily newspaper article described it as the first SM mall on Panay. It is also a meeting spot that Ilonggos understand right away. Telling a taxi or Grab driver "SM City Iloilo" or "SM Diversion" is usually enough.

blocks.title: A complex built up in stages

children.text: The Main Building, South Point, North Point and SM Strata are all connected, so the walking distances add up. On your first visit, check the building and floor on the entrance directory first. Crossing the connecting footbridge makes it easy to move from one building to another.

The South Point has a dining-focused area, and Wikipedia says the SM Food Hall here was the third in the Philippines. With everything from Filipino dishes to Japanese, Korean and fast food, it is a good place to size up your tastes before trying local noodles such as Iloilo's famous La Paz batchoy. Tenants keep changing, so check the dining list on SM's official page for the latest.

According to Wikipedia, Cinemas 1 to 4 closed for renovation in 2022 and reopened on February 28, 2023, two Director's Club cinemas opened on April 22, 2023, and the IMAX with Laser theater opened on November 15, 2023. It is a good place to rest on a rainy afternoon or a very hot day. Check showtimes and prices in the SM Cinema app or on-site information.

There is a Cyberzone gathering electronics, phones and computer accessories, and an expanded Cyberzone opened on August 28, 2025. It helps when you suddenly need a charger or cable. For money exchange, use the mall's exchange counters or a bank, but rates differ from shop to shop, so compare one or two.

At SM Supermarket you can pick up Filipino snacks, dried mango, coffee, coconut products and regional snacks. It is also a good place for last-minute gift shopping before heading to the airport. If you want to take home Iloilo's signature foods, be sure to check price tags and expiration dates.

The redevelopment announced in November 2025, costing about ₱2.3 billion, includes motion-sensor escalators, a large skylight and a multi-level North Block car park. First-in-Iloilo brands such as Decathlon, TGI Fridays and Chili's have also been announced. Which areas are open differs from time to time, so check local information.

items.title: Half-day shopping and dining route
items.subtitle: From opening time through the afternoon

children.text: The mall opens every day at
. Arriving right after opening means fewer people and easier browsing. Pass the bag check at the entrance and scan the directory for the layout of buildings and floors.
Pick out gift snacks, dried mango and coffee at SM Supermarket, and take care of errands such as money exchange, a telecom shop and the pharmacy at this time.
Have lunch at the South Point dining area or the food hall. Lines can get long around noon, so it is best to go around 11:30.
Look around the SM Store and Cyberzone in the Main Building, and walk the footbridge connection to the SM Strata side.
Finish with a movie or a rest at a cafe. Check IMAX showtimes in the app beforehand.
The air conditioning inside is strong, so a thin jacket is useful.

items.title: Fitting it into an Iloilo day
items.subtitle: Morning sightseeing, then a meal and rest at the mall

children.text: In the morning, visit historic places such as Jaro Cathedral or Molo Church. Both are a short drive from the mall.
Escape the midday heat by heading to the mall for lunch and a rest.
Do your shopping, then watch a movie or sort out your plans at a cafe.
Around sunset, go to the Iloilo River Esplanade and walk along the river.
On rainy days, cut down the morning sightseeing and spend more time at the mall.
There are direct flights from Manila (NAIA) to Iloilo International Airport (ILO), and the flight takes a little over an hour. Airlines and times change by season, so check before booking.

children.text: Vans run between the airport and the mall, and one report puts the fare at about
. They wait until full before leaving, so allow extra time.
Fares and travel times for taxis and Grab vary greatly with traffic, so check the app quote or the meter.

items.title: Taxis and jeepneys in the city

children.text: From central Iloilo, take a taxi or Grab to the mall. Tell the driver "SM City Iloilo" or "SM Diversion" as the destination.

Jeepneys and other city transport also pass along Diversion Road, but routes and fares change, so check locally. Wikipedia says the ground level of SM Strata serves as a transport terminal and is linked to the mall by a footbridge.
Because it is an indoor mall, you can go any time of year. Iloilo has dry and rainy seasons, and with frequent afternoon showers in the rainy season, the mall serves as a refuge between plans.

Day of the week and time of day affect crowds more than the weather. Weekday daytime is relatively quiet, while Friday evenings, weekends and payday weeks are busy. Year-end hours and events change and it is the busiest time, so check holiday hours on SM's official page.

Right next to the mall in the SM Strata area is the 10-storey, 199-room Park Inn by Radisson Iloilo, which Wikipedia calls the first Park Inn hotel in the Visayas. Being close to the mall makes it easy to get around, and handy on days you arrive late or leave early from the airport. Room rates vary a lot by season, so check booking sites.

Meals are easy to find in the mall's food hall and dining areas, with Korean, Japanese and fast food all available. Since you are in Iloilo, it is also worth trying Panay specialties outside the mall such as La Paz batchoy or kansi. Tenants keep changing, so check the dining list on SM's official page.
Tell Grab or taxi drivers "SM City Iloilo" or "SM Diversion" and they will understand.
The mall has several buildings, so when meeting someone, agree on the building name, floor and shop name.
Hours are normally 10:00–22:00 daily but change on holidays. Check SM's official page at year-end.
When heading to the airport, vans wait until they are full, so leave extra time before your flight.
The air conditioning inside is strong, so bring a thin jacket.
There may be construction zones, so follow the signs, and check the shops you want to visit in the SM app or on the official page first.
Compare one or two places for money exchange and SIM cards, and bring your passport.
Redevelopment and new construction continue, so some areas may be closed or tenants may change. Please check the latest announcements before you go.
There are bag checks at every entrance, so cooperate, and watch for pickpockets and lost phones on crowded days.
Make sure the taxi uses the meter, and if a driver quotes a fixed fare at the airport, compare it with a Grab quote.
When a typhoon approaches, the mall's hours may change, so check SM's official announcements.
Diversion Road is congested, so use the footbridge or the signals when crossing.
Prices, hours and other changing information may differ after the date of this guide.

A cathedral in the Jaro district, a short drive from the mall, so you can plan a morning of sightseeing followed by lunch at the mall.
